requirements.description: Compile VidMuse video and image fields into the existing Aion unified model request
Support direct MCP mappings and backward-compatible assisted mappings
Import CSV/TSV structured cells and JSON arrays or items envelopes without dropping unrelated columns
Validate MCP structures, prompt references, live model configuration, and verified model compatibility rules per case
Provide explicit Seedance/H3 keyframe-to-reference conversion with deterministic numbering and visible warnings
Persist compiler audit data and show normalized inputs, bindings, and final Aion requests in preflight
Preserve old snapshots plus Worker, assets, writeback, dataset versions, and human-evaluation behavior without migration
Pass non-database tests, builds, and desktop/mobile browser QA; database rerun is environment-blocked
